name: Singing Pets AI Video
blurb: One photo of your pet in: towel on, hair dryer for a mic, and it belts out the chorus with the song in the clip.

prompts.label: Template prompt
prompts.text: Use the photo as the pet and keep it recognisable from the first frame to the last: same species and breed, fur colour and markings, eyes, ears and size. Just after bath time in a bright white-tiled bathroom, vertical 9:16, realistic phone video. The pet sits upright in the bathtub with a fluffy white towel wrapped around its waist, fur still damp, holding a black hair dryer up in one front paw like a microphone while the warm air ruffles the fur on top of its head. It tips its head back, closes its eyes and sings a big, heartfelt pop chorus, its mouth opening and closing in time with every note; then it opens its eyes, leans toward the camera for the high note and waves its free paw. Locked-off camera at eye level, soft bathroom light, one continuous take. The pet keeps real animal anatomy: paws, never human hands. Audio: a catchy original pop chorus sung by a playful animal-like voice, the hum of the hair dryer and a little bathroom echo. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.
